purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel geometry access review.
assessment: Kanazawa’s official sources refer to cadastral-map and cadastral-register records, land-number reference maps, and the city open-data/map-information platform. Property-tax registers are available to owners and other legally eligible parties through documented application; the public map portal advertises facility maps and a map API but the reviewed catalogue did not expose a parcel-feature dataset or schema. No safe anonymous parcel-vector route or WUP-point geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: Official Kanazawa materials identify city cadastral-map records and land-number reference mapping, while property-tax register inspection is limited to owners, agents, heirs or tenants with proof. No point-specific public geometry was confirmed.
